title: Detailed birthday cake with candles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cakeGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd9a0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0a860'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='icingGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3d1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff7fb0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='plateGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d8e6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9fb6e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='44' ry='7' fill='#8fa8dd'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='44' ry='7' fill='url(#plateGrad)'/>

  <!-- cake base layer -->
  <rect x='14' y='58' width='72' height='28' rx='4' fill='url(#cakeGrad)'/>
  <!-- base shading bands -->
  <rect x='14' y='78' width='72' height='8' rx='4' fill='#d98f47'/>
  <rect x='14' y='58' width='72' height='14' rx='4' fill='#ffe4b8' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- icing drip on base -->
  <path d='M14 62 Q20 70 26 62 Q32 70 38 62 Q44 70 50 62 Q56 70 62 62 Q68 70 74 62 Q80 68 86 62 L86 58 L14 58 Z' fill='url(#icingGrad)'/>

  <!-- top layer -->
  <rect x='22' y='40' width='56' height='24' rx='4' fill='url(#cakeGrad)'/>
  <rect x='22' y='56' width='56' height='8' rx='4' fill='#d98f47'/>
  <rect x='22' y='40' width='56' height='12' rx='4' fill='#ffe4b8' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- icing drip top layer -->
  <path d='M22 44 Q27 52 32 44 Q37 52 42 44 Q47 52 52 44 Q57 52 62 44 Q67 52 72 44 Q75 50 78 44 L78 40 L22 40 Z' fill='url(#icingGrad)'/>

  <!-- top icing surface -->
  <rect x='22' y='37' width='56' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff9cc4'/>

  <!-- sprinkles on base -->
  <rect x='20' y='72' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8fd9ff' transform='rotate(20 22 73)'/>
  <rect x='34' y='74' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c8ff8f' transform='rotate(-15 36 75)'/>
  <rect x='50' y='72' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66' transform='rotate(10 52 73)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='74' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#d79cff' transform='rotate(-20 68 75)'/>
  <rect x='78' y='71' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8fd9ff' transform='rotate(25 80 72)'/>

  <!-- sprinkles on top layer -->
  <rect x='28' y='52' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66' transform='rotate(15 30 53)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='54' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8fd9ff' transform='rotate(-18 46 55)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='52' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c8ff8f' transform='rotate(12 62 53)'/>
  <rect x='70' y='55' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#d79cff' transform='rotate(-22 72 56)'/>

  <!-- candles -->
  <!-- candle 1 -->
  <rect x='32' y='22' width='4' height='16' rx='1' fill='#6ec6ff'/>
  <rect x='32' y='22' width='2' height='16' fill='#a8e0ff'/>
  <rect x='32' y='26' width='4' height='2' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
  <rect x='32' y='32' width='4' height='2' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
  <!-- flame 1 -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='19' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='19.5' rx='1.6' ry='2.6' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- candle 2 -->
  <rect x='46' y='18' width='4' height='20' rx='1' fill='#ffb37f'/>
  <rect x='46' y='18' width='2' height='20' fill='#ffd2b0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='23' width='4' height='2' fill='#66cc99'/>
  <rect x='46' y='30' width='4' height='2' fill='#66cc99'/>
  <!-- flame 2 -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='15' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='15.5' rx='1.6' ry='2.6' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- candle 3 -->
  <rect x='60' y='22' width='4' height='16' rx='1' fill='#b98fff'/>
  <rect x='60' y='22' width='2' height='16' fill='#dcc2ff'/>
  <rect x='60' y='26' width='4' height='2' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <rect x='60' y='32' width='4' height='2' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- flame 3 -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='19' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='19.5' rx='1.6' ry='2.6' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- candle 4 (tall center) -->
  <rect x='39' y='16' width='4' height='22' rx='1' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <rect x='39' y='16' width='2' height='22' fill='#ffc2d5'/>
  <rect x='39' y='21' width='4' height='2' fill='#8fdeff'/>
  <rect x='39' y='28' width='4' height='2' fill='#8fdeff'/>
  <!-- flame 4 -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='13' rx='3.2' ry='5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='13.5' rx='1.7' ry='2.8' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- candle 5 -->
  <rect x='54' y='16' width='4' height='22' rx='1' fill='#9de87f'/>
  <rect x='54' y='16' width='2' height='22' fill='#c8f7b5'/>
  <rect x='54' y='21' width='4' height='2' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <rect x='54' y='28' width='4' height='2' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <!-- flame 5 -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='13' rx='3.2' ry='5' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='13.5' rx='1.7' ry='2.8' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- glow around flames -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='13' r='7' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.18'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='13' r='7' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.18'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='19' r='6' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='15' r='6' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='19' r='6' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.15'/>
</svg>
